map.货物分类与最大装载示例: Cargo classification and maximum loading example
map.：某货体积 150 m³、重 100 t，SF = 150÷100 = 1.5: : a cargo of 150 m³ weighing 100 t has SF = 150÷100 = 1.5 m³/t (about 53.82 ft³/LT) and a density of 100÷150 ≈ 0.67 t/m³, so it is light goods (volume-limited, 1.3 ≤ SF < 2.0). Loading 5000 t at SF 1.5 into 8000 m³ and 10000 t of capacity needs 5000×1.5 = 7500 m³, so volume utilization is 93.75% and weight utilization 50%. The volume limit caps the load at 8000÷1.5 ≈ 5333 t, below the 10000 t weight capacity, so volume is the bottleneck and at most 5333 t can be loaded.
map.积载因数 SF 大说明什么？: What Does a Large Stowage Factor SF Mean?
map.SF = 体积/重量，值越大越「泡」（轻货），舱容先满而载重有余；SF 越小越「: SF = volume/weight. The larger the value the "fluffier" the cargo (light goods), so volume fills first while weight capacity is left over; the smaller the value the "denser" it is (heavy goods), so weight fills first while volume is left over. Rule-of-thumb bands: under 0.6 heavy, 0.6–1.3 medium, 1.3–2.0 light, 2.0 and above very light.
map.舱容受限和载重受限怎么判断？: How Do I Tell Volume-Limited from Weight-Limited?
map.最大装载 = min(舱容÷SF, 载重)。若 舱容÷SF ≤ 载重 → 舱容受: Maximum load = min(volume ÷ SF, weight capacity). If volume ÷ SF ≤ weight capacity the volume is binding (light goods), otherwise weight is binding (heavy goods). Make sure the actual cargo does not exceed the smaller of the two, so you neither exceed volume nor exceed weight.
